newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Meekatharra says to restructure float.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Meekatharra says to restructure float.

text.p: Meekatharra Minerals Ltd said on Thursday it intended to restructure the proposed listing in Canada of the majority of its Indonesian gold holdings.

Meekatharra said it had been advised by a senior tax counsel that the currently proposed reverse takeover structure put in place for the flotation of NM Gold Corp had deemed capital gains tax implications for the company.
This contradicted professional professional advice the company had received earlier, it said.
"The flotation will not proceed as currently structured. All monies and commitments tendered are being returned to the applicants," Meekatharra said.

The company said the due diligence report on the Indonesian properties was completed two weeks ago and an independent geologist's report consistent with Canadian National Policy 2A had been confirmed as containing "properties of merit" for the purpose of listing on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
"These reports make up the bulk of the data required for successful flotation," it said.
"The directors intend to restructure the float and the completion of the above reports should allow the restructured float to proceed expeditiously," the company said.
Meekatharra had planned to offer about 40 percent of the newly formed Canadian subsidary to institutional investors through a private placement, raising about C$33 million, the company said in July.
The equity raising was earmarked to help fund its US$15 million Way Linggo gold and silver project in Sumatra and finance exploration programmes in Indonesia.
